dataset.dictionary:
# Monthly hospitalization among dialysis patients — data dictionary (demo)

One row is one patient-month. Rows are attributed to the dialysis facility (`FACILITY`) where the patient was treated. The outcome is `HOSPITALIZED`; a higher rate is worse. The risk adjusters are the committee set listed in `specification.json`.

**This file is synthetic.** It was generated by `Agent/sim/make_examples.R` from a model with known facility effects, patient-level dependence and planted departures; `truth.json` records them. No real patient or facility data entered it.

| column | meaning |
|---|---|
| `FACILITY` | Dialysis facility identifier (synthetic). |
| `PATIENT` | Patient identifier (synthetic). A patient contributes one row per month on dialysis. |
| `HOSPITALIZED` | 1 if the patient was admitted to hospital during the month, 0 otherwise. The outcome; a higher rate is worse. |
| `AGE` | Age in years at the start of the month (or at the index admission). |
| `FEMALE` | 1 if female. |
| `DIABETES` | 1 if diabetes is recorded as the cause of ESRD or a comorbidity. |
| `HEART_FAILURE` | 1 if congestive heart failure is recorded. |
| `COPD` | 1 if chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is recorded. |
| `BMI` | Body mass index at the start of dialysis. |
| `YEARS_ON_DIALYSIS` | Years since the start of dialysis. |
| `NURSING_HOME` | 1 if the patient resides in a nursing home. |
| `ALBUMIN` | Serum albumin (g/dL), the most recent value in the month. |
| `HEMOGLOBIN` | Hemoglobin (g/dL), the most recent value in the month. |
| `MONTH` | Calendar month of the patient-month within the year. |
| `YEAR` | Reporting year (constant within a file). |

## What is planted (from `truth.json`)

- Facilities truly worse than the norm: F00087, F00131, F00124, F00143, F00067, F00164 (two per size tertile; effects {'large': 1.1, 'medium': 1.4, 'small': 1.8} on the logit scale, larger where the facility is smaller).
- Facilities truly better: F00109, F00186, F00195, F00006.
- Facilities whose outcomes are all zero (invariant): F00032, F00096.
- Facilities with three patients or fewer: 15.
- A decoy with an extreme case mix and a true effect of zero: F00127.
- A patient random effect of scale 1 (within-patient correlation); ordinary facilities have a small spread of effects (sd 0.1).

truth.decoy_note: an extreme case mix (nursing-home residents frequent, albumin low) with a true effect of exactly zero: a pooled model flags it, a fixed-effects model does not

actions.name: fit
actions.purpose: fit the fixed provider effects logistic model on the declared adjusters (SerBIN)

actions.name: select_adjusters
actions.purpose: select the adjustment set by penalized regression with the provider effects kept unpenalized (cross-validated lasso or group lasso)

actions.name: standardize
actions.purpose: indirect and direct standardized ratios and rates against the norm

actions.name: test_providers
actions.purpose: test every provider's effect against the norm with one statistic and variance treatment

actions.name: empirical_null
actions.purpose: fit the size-stratified empirical null to one test's statistics and re-flag under it

actions.name: test_measure
actions.purpose: test the directly standardized rate on its own scale (the transported test)

actions.name: evaluate_model
actions.purpose: discrimination (C statistic overall and within provider) and calibration by decile of the risk-adjustment model

actions.name: compare_axes
actions.purpose: flags under the other admissible choice on one axis, with the providers that change status

actions.name: figure
actions.purpose: render one display from the catalogue for one result

actions.name: calibrate_tests
actions.purpose: simulate this design (outcomes drawn from the fitted risk model at the norm, with the within-patient correlation matched), with departures of a given odds ratio planted in a small share of the providers, and measure each admissible test's type I error per tail on the providers at the norm and its power on the planted ones, under both reference distributions; the reported test is then the one with the most power whose type I error stays near the nominal level

actions.name: subset
actions.purpose: one provider's observed and expected events by patient group, and its case mix against the population (why is this provider flagged?)

actions.name: finish
actions.purpose: end the analysis and write the report
